appearance: A small office of dark panelled wood, walls lined floor to ceiling with ledger boxes. A heavy desk, a single tall window with small panes, a lamp, and stacked papers weighted with stones.
_spectrumWhy: ⛑ SNG-622 — the last two with an empty spectrum, both player-minted at the Hub. ⚠️ Ossian's office is where Edvar Crane's files went — Warden Coll names it, 'the Deep Registry, Ossian annex, two streets north, green shutter' — so it is a record-keeping room and reads ordered and concrete. The street outside it is an ordinary busy street, which is a real answer and not a shrug.
